reason: Novo Nordisk discontinued semaglutide's Alzheimer's disease program after Phase 3 EVOKE (NCT04777396) and EVOKE Plus (NCT04777409) both missed their primary endpoint. ct.gov itself records both trials as COMPLETED rather than TERMINATED/WITHDRAWN, so the ct.gov-status-derived rollup (_DRUG_ROLLUP_STATUS_PRIORITY_INVESTIGATIONAL in drug_classification.py) has no per-trial signal to pick up the way it does for a drug like gantenerumab.
source: Novo Nordisk EVOKE/EVOKE Plus topline results (2025)
